values.note: $24 per site. A one-time $11 fee to enter the Eleven Mile Canyon Recreation Area (annual pass $100); $11 for a third vehicle.

fees.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/psicc/recreation/springer-gulch-campground ('$24 fee per site for overnight camping ... $11 fee for a third vehicle') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233718/rates (Peak Season 2027-05-14 to 2027-10-10: STANDARD NONELECTRIC 24) + recreation.gov notice ('one-time fee of $11.00 to enter Eleven Mile Canyon Recreation Area'), read 2026-10-27

discounts.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/psicc/recreation/springer-gulch-campground ('The Interagency Senior Pass and the Interagency Access Pass qualify for a 50% discount at concessionaire-run campsites'), read 2026-10-27

values.note: Parking spurs 20-28 ft; RVs or trailers 25 ft maximum. recreation.gov's catalog lists 14 sites, 4 of them tent-only; the rest are back-ins of 20-28 ft. One RV per site.

sites.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/psicc/recreation/springer-gulch-campground ('It has 15 campsites with parking spurs 20-28 feet and a maximum trailer length of 25 feet'; 'The max length for RVs or trailers is 25 feet') + recreation.gov per-site catalog, read 2026-10-27

values.note: Drinking water from a hand pump. Firewood sold at the host site.

facilities.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/psicc/recreation/springer-gulch-campground ('Vault toilet(s)'; 'Potable water is available at this site. A hand pump is available.') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233718, read 2026-10-27

values.note: Mid-May to mid-October, weather dependent; not all services early or late in the season.

season.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/psicc/recreation/springer-gulch-campground ('This campground is open mid-May to mid-October, weather dependent.'), read 2026-10-27

values.note: Reserve on recreation.gov or at 877-444-6777; booking closes 5 days before arrival (the Forest Service says four) and unreserved sites become first-come walk-ups. Reservations run May 14 to October 10 in 2027. Weekend minimum 2 nights, holiday weekends 3; recreation.gov marks the weekend minimum soft, so it may be relaxed for a same-day booking, and walk-ups are exempt.

booking.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/psicc/recreation/springer-gulch-campground ('Call 877-444-6777 or visit recreation.gov at least four days in advance. A minimum stay on Friday and Saturday night is required on weekends. A three-night minimum stay is required on holiday weekends. Walk-ups are exempt from the nightly minimum.'; 14-night limit) + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233718 (notice 'Sites not reserved 5 days before become walk-up'; rules minWeekendStay 2 'soft', reservationCutOff 5, maxConsecutiveStay 14) + /rates (Peak Season 2027-05-14 to 2027-10-10), read 2026-10-27

note: In Eleven Mile Canyon about 6 miles up County Road 96, a short walk from the South Platte River; scattered ponderosa, aspen and fir. Concessionaire-run (recreation.gov contact (661) 702-1420). Bear closure order: store attractants hard-sided. --Claude
